_comment: ARM 35 — the MASK EXTREME at scale, CONTROL half.  303-station EXT-CB, obs mask 30,
iono cutoff 30, 20 min (40 epochs).  Paired with arm 36 (_lv4), which differs by the
single knob network.rx_cb_carry_step_gate.
WHY 30/30 AT 305 STATIONS (user direction, 2026-08-05).  Three measured results point
here and they do not obviously agree:
§21    the LEVEL gain belongs to the OBSERVATION mask (10 -> 15 is worth 5-6 TECU at
either iono cutoff); the RESIDUAL cost belongs to the IONO cutoff (25 -> 15
costs +27..46 % postfit phase rms at either obs mask).
§20.2  station support halves every level metric; the 303-sta IGNITION hour (-1.98)
beats any settled hour the 61-sta canonical reaches in twelve.
arm 34 LV-4's level effect INVERTS with the obs mask: -28.4 TECU vs GIM at obs 10,
-2.6 at obs 15 (same iono cutoff 25, same everything else).
So both the mask axis and the station axis point the same way, and LV-4's sign follows
the mask.  This arm asks whether that continues, or turns around.
AT 30/30 THE IONO CUTOFF STOPS BINDING.  With every surviving LOS already >= 30 deg,
a cutoff of 30 admits all of them as SH constraint rows.  So this is not '15/15 but
more so' — it is 'the 15-30 deg band deleted from the solution entirely, and no
further screening on what remains'.  §21's two knobs collapse into one here, which is
why the pair is run at a single mask setting rather than as another 2x2.
THE PREDICTION IS THAT THIS DOES NOT KEEP HELPING, AND THE REASON IS §21.1.  a00's
only handle is MAPPING-FUNCTION SPREAD; it needs low-elevation lines of sight to be
separable from the receiver-DCB common mode at all.  Raising the obs mask trades two
effects against each other — less low-elevation code multipath reaching the SH field
(helps, and is the whole of §21's +5..6 TECU) versus less mapping spread to estimate
a00 with (hurts).  At 10 -> 15 the first dominates.  At 30 the second should.
THE DIAGNOSTIC THAT DECIDES IT, and it is cheap: a00's POSTERIOR sigma against its
own 32.24 +- 2.0 TECU prior (network_vtec_sh.csv, n=0 m=0, std_tecu).  Measured today:
ext305_dual_1h        (obs 10)  a00 std median 0.4335
ext63_dual_3h_m15i25  (obs 15)  a00 std median 0.7099
ext63_dual_1h_lv4_m15i25        a00 std median 0.6488
All are data-dominated with wide margin to the prior's 2.0.  If obs mask 30 pushes
std_tecu toward 2.0, a00 is being set by the PRIOR and not by the network, and any
level agreement with GIM at 30/30 is CIRCULAR (the prior is 32.24, the GIM 00h global
mean is 32.0).  Read std_tecu BEFORE reading the level in these two arms.
WHAT IS AND IS NOT GRADEABLE HERE:
- INVARIANT-LEGAL: median postfit phase rms (network_pf_keyed.csv, STA rows) between
arm 35 and arm 36.  The two arms are one knob apart at identical masks, so the
observation set is identical and the LV-4 data-side cost is directly comparable to
§19.3's +64 % (obs 10) and arm 34's +35 % (obs 15).  This is the grade.
- DIAGNOSTIC ONLY: a00 and a00-GIM (frame quantities, invariant #5 / §17 item 0).
- NOT COMPARABLE ACROSS THE MASK: arm 35 vs any 10/25 or 15/25 arm.  Observation
counts differ by construction, so read DIRECTION, not delta — §21's own caveat.
20 MIN IS IGNITION AND IS LABELLED AS SUCH.  §14 measured a ~2 h level convergence
budget at 61 stations; §20.2 found essentially no ignition transient at 303 (hour-0
mean -1.98 +- 3.66), which is the only reason a 40-epoch level read is worth taking at
all.  It is still a third of that hour.  No settled-level verdict comes out of this
pair; what comes out is the mask DIRECTION, the a00 sigma, and the LV-4 rms delta.
Extends _ext305_gps_dual_1h.json for the 303-station list, overriding its pinned 10/25
masks.  Fresh lineage, own paths; never resume onto another arm's snapshot.
